title: Proper-support composition normalized by the right-derived unit
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and let (b,q,p,v) be a commuting square of Noetherian schemes with q,p proper and b,v separated quasi-compact etale. Assume compactifications of b,v,qv,bp. Write S_b,S_v for sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension], and c_b,c_v for its canonical maps to direct image [def-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-to-star-map]. Suppose a natural transformation theta:q_* S_v -> S_b p_* satisfies theta_F followed by p_*(c_b,F) and the b,p direct-image compositor equals c_v,q_*F followed by the q,v compositor to (bp)_*F, for every F. Transport the chosen compact-support compositor from F_q F_v to F_b F_p by the chosen proper and graph comparisons [def-pur-graph-chosen-proper-comparison, def-pur-graph-chosen-etale-comparison]. After precomposing with the canonical unit of Rq_* followed by D(S_v), this word equals Q_h of the degreewise theta followed by the canonical unit of D(S_b) followed by Rp_* [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons, lem-asd-compact-support-graph-derived-isomorphism, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. The precise unit factors are in the Lean statement. No Cartesian hypothesis and no mate appears.

source.place: Tags 0F7B (construction on K-injective complexes and equality of support subsheaves), 0F7F, 0F7I and 0F7J (tower comparison). Graph inclusion: etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L.

proof.text: Take the chosen compactification c of b and its proper postcomposition c.postcomp p. Form tau from theta, the sheaf graph map for b, and the ordinary c.g,p direct-image compositor. Naturality and associativity of direct-image composition and graph sheaf normalization show that tau followed by the compactification inclusion equals the normalized v-sum inclusion on q_*; substitute htheta. This is postcomp_sheaf_normalization in Lean.

Apply graph_proper_precomposition_unit to the proper map q, the etale map v, and the single compactification c.postcomp p with the preceding tau. This handles only the proper-first path; its remaining geometric argument has no second factorization.

For the etale-first path use graph_proper_postcomposition. Expand the inverse graph comparison by its homotopy component formula. Expand the composite right-derived unit, cancel the exact-functor factor, use naturality of the proper unit and of the proper derived compositor, and apply its unit factorization. These are the complete private proofs proper_comp_unit, postcomposition_unit and postcomp_word. Choosing c to be the already chosen compactification makes the graph comparison expansion definitional, so no extra graph-refinement theorem is required.

Postcompose the desired unit equality with the inverse of its etale-first terminal word followed by the inverse model-to-chosen comparison. Cancel the adjacent isomorphisms in the source word. The proper-first equation and the proved etale-first unit equation now agree by functoriality of degreewise theta followed by the sheaf graph map. Cancel the invertible postcomposition. This proves the stated equality of natural transformations unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F7B, 0F7I and 0F7J. D4 reduction to the proper-first normalization in one compactification; etale-first path and unit pasting proved in Lean.

theorem graph_proper_support_unit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {W Y' Z Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian W] [IsNoetherian Y'] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (q : W ⟶ Y') [IsProper q] (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper p]
    (b : W ⟶ Z) [Etale b] [IsSeparated b] [QuasiCompact b]
    (v : Y' ⟶ Y) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (sq : CommSq b q p v)
    [HasCompactification b] [HasCompactification v]
    [HasCompactification (q ≫ v)] [HasCompactification (b ≫ p)]
    (θ : lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q ⋙
        etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance ⟶
      etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p)
    (hθ : (∀ F : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A),
      θ.app F ≫
          (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).map
            (etaleLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b F) ≫
          (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b p).hom.app F =
        etaleLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v
            ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).obj F) ≫
          (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q v (b ≫ p) sq.w).hom.app F)) :
    (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryUnit
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q)
      (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)) ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Qh
    (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (graphChosenProperComparison A q).symm
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q)
        (graphChosenEtaleComparison A v).symm ≪≫
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A q v ≪≫
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr A sq.w.symm ≪≫
      (unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A b p).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (graphChosenEtaleComparison A b)
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory
        (graphChosenProperComparison A p)).hom =
    Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory θ (.up ℤ)) DerivedCategory.Qh ≫
      Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompRightDerivedFunctorUnit
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance)
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p)
